name: Silicon Valley Defense Group
role_summary: 501(c)(3) operator of the NatSec100 ranking surface; convener bridging tech, capital, and USG. Founded from 2015 McCain mandate; founders James Cross and Chris O'Donnell; Executive Director Mike Keating (from 2025); prior EDs Sam Gray, Jacqueline Tame.
notes: Board chair Chris Donaghey (also CEO, Applied Energetics per 2026 report quote block).

name: J.P. Morgan
role_summary: NatSec100 title sponsor from 2024 onward; 2026 launch hosted at JPM HQ NYC. John China (Co-Head Innovation Economy) quoted in 2026 release.
notes: Sponsorship is a documented convening/validation relationship, not a portfolio edge.

name: Franklin Templeton
role_summary: NatSec100 scoring-methodology partner all four years; James Cross is both SVDG co-founder and Franklin private-investing co-head.
notes: Dual-role (ranking-surface co-founder + capital surface) is a graph fact; no coordination inference.

name: Balyasny Asset Management
role_summary: NatSec100 scoring-methodology partner all four years (algorithm development, data analytics).

name: Pryzm
role_summary: Contracting-data platform; 2026 NatSec100 integrates Pryzm federal-award data as a direct ranking input for the first time.
notes: Methodology-infrastructure actor; its integration produced the largest single-year rank movements in report history (per SVDG).

name: In-Q-Tel
role_summary: CIA-chartered nonprofit strategic investor; #1 NatSec100 investor by portfolio count in 2023 (34 of 100), 2024 (>33%), and 2026 (33).

name: Gaingels
role_summary: High-volume investor; top NatSec100 investor lists 2023, 2024, 2026 (30 portfolio companies in 2026). SVDG notes no specific national-security thesis.

name: Alumni Ventures
role_summary: High-volume investor; top NatSec100 investor lists 2023, 2024, 2026 (25 in 2026).

name: Lockheed Martin Ventures
role_summary: Top defense CVC on NatSec100 investor lists 2023, 2024, 2026 (14 in 2026); fund raised to $1B in 2025-26; 60+ portfolio companies became LM suppliers, $750M+ contracts to portfolio companies per 2026 report.
notes: Prime-CVC-to-supplier conversion pattern documented in operator's own report.

name: Washington Harbour Partners
role_summary: Defense-focused investor; 16 NatSec100 portfolio companies (2026 report); self-reported 11 portfolio companies on 2025 list.
notes: 2026 report spells 'Washington Harbour'; substack rendering 'Washington Harbor' normalized.

name: BlackRock
role_summary: First appearance on NatSec100 top-investor list in 2026 with 11 portfolio companies; flagged by SVDG as institutional-capital entry signal.
